### ts-token-variable
async function fetchRepos(token: string) {
  const res = await fetch("https://api.github.com/user/repos", {
    headers: { Accept: "application/vnd.github+json", Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  if (res.status === 401) throw new Error("token expired");
  return res.json();
}

### docs-sk-placeholders
Set OPENAI_API_KEY to your key (it starts with sk-...). Project keys look like sk-proj-... and Anthropic keys like sk-ant-api03-...; never paste one here. In the examples below we write sk-xxxx.
### docs-angle-placeholders
Replace <your-api-key> with the key from the dashboard, and <YOUR_ORG_ID> with your organization id.
### docs-upper-placeholders
API_KEY=YOUR_API_KEY
WEBHOOK_SECRET=REPLACE_ME
### docs-bearer-placeholder
Every request carries an `Authorization: Bearer <access-token>` header; a missing one gets a 401.
### docs-slack-placeholder
Slack bot tokens start with xoxb-..., app tokens with xapp-...
